correctness.rationale: All conditional computations verify. Ran committed verifier: VERIFY_OK rows=19449 forests_rechecked=485; both headline witnesses exact; PAIR_SAMPLE_OK 100. Independently re-derived: per-n class counts 1,2,5,16,63,318,2045,16999 with sums 1,3,14,96,895,11751,214708,5594463 matching DRAFT; per-n emax=n! at id 1 and emin=1 at last id; stored childforms pairwise unique per n; forest count 485 (1,2,4,9,20,48,115,286). Wrote independent closure+DP and brute-force permutation counters: headline 8#14584 e=9 with all four incomparable pairs splitting 6-3 (Pr 2/3, delta=1/3) and 8#558 e=2520 with pair (1,8) 2484-36 (min Pr 1/70) both confirmed by brute force; 5 random forest rows agree with brute force; exhaustive independent pair recomputation for all n=4,5,6 classes confirms e_xy+e_yx=e on every pair, per-n most-lopsided fractions 1/6,1/10,1/20, and min delta 1/3 with every non-chain delta>=1/3. DP, augmented-poset closure stabilization, and forest hook-length code paths reviewed and sound. Universal 'every unlabelled poset' wording depends on external Atlas seed completeness (counts+syntactic uniqueness verified, 18/18 spot standard-form checks reported, exhaustive non-isomorphism not re-proved), which DRAFT Sec.6 honestly discloses; conditional census claims are proved.

originality.rationale: Substantive gap vs nearest priors verified live, not by timestamp. OEIS A000112 stores only bare counts 1,1,2,5,16,63,318,2045,16999,... to 16 with no per-poset e(P), sorting probabilities, or replay logs. Brinkmann-McKay JIS 2005 enumerates isomorphism-class counts to 15/16 points (counts only), no per-class e(P) census. FindStat Posets collection definition states database contains all posets of size at most 7 only, so n=8 is outside. FindStat St000100 definition is P.linear_extensions().cardinality() but value file has only 714 rows total (confirmed by download count), hence sparse vs 2045 needed at n=7 and 16999 at n=8. FindStat St000848/St000849 balance statistics likewise sparse samples. Chapel Hill Atlas provides representatives to m=9 plus hook/d-complete lists but no linear-extension or sorting-probability table. No source gives per-class exact e(P) for all 19449 classes to n=8 with full sorting-probability extrema, 1/70 lopsided extremal, and delta=1/3 witness with replay logs; values are not mechanically implied by class counts (e(P) #P-hard in general) and require new computation.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object class motivated before computation: per-class linear-extension counts e(P), per-n sorting-probability extremes, certified delta=1/3 witness 8#14584 and 1/70 lopsided extremal 8#558 for unlabelled posets n<=8. Motivation predates computation via Kahn-Saks 1/3-2/3 balance program and sorting-under-partial-information benchmarks (FindStat St000848 description cites Kislitsyn/Kahn-Saks/Brightwell-Felsner-Trotter/Olson-Sagan; Atlas/Chapel Hill context). Scope n<=8 is the natural next closed level (FindStat databased to 7; 2^8 ideal DP exactly enumerable). Future researchers can need the precise e(P)/extremal-pair facts as ground-truth benchmarks and conjecture tests. This is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained number: witness and extrema carry explicit 1/3-2/3 interpretation with exact splits and replay logs. Incomplete-census caveat (seed non-isomorphism inherited) is honestly disclosed and does not erase the independently valuable exact headline.
